parts.name: Translation Blade
parts.Basic_description: This is the translation blade of a utility knife, made of stainless steel. It is a thin, sharp component designed for cutting.
parts.Functional_description: The blade performs the cutting function. It can slide in and out of the base body for safety and precision control.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly along the body of the knife, extending and retracting through a sliding mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of a utility knife, made of ABS plastic. It serves as the handle and housing for the blade.
parts.Functional_description: The base body provides grip and control for the user, houses the blade, and includes the mechanism for blade translation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the main structure that supports the moving blade.
